title: ADHD Test
description: See how often you face challenges with focus, self-regulation, and hyperactivity.

questions.asrs_1: How often do you have trouble wrapping up the final details of a task once the hardest part is done?
questions.asrs_2: How often do you have difficulty getting things in order when a task requires a lot of organization?
questions.asrs_3: How often do you forget appointments or obligations?
questions.asrs_4: When given a task that needs a lot of thought, how often do you avoid it or delay getting started?
questions.asrs_5: How often do you fidget or squirm with your hands or feet when you have to sit for a long time?
questions.asrs_6: How often do you feel overly active, as if driven by a motor?
questions.asrs_7: How often do you make careless mistakes when working on a boring or difficult project?
questions.asrs_8: How often do you have trouble keeping your attention on boring work?
questions.asrs_9: How often do you have trouble concentrating on what people say to you, even when they're speaking to you directly?
questions.asrs_10: How often do you misplace things or have trouble finding them at home or at work?
questions.asrs_11: How often are you distracted by activity or noise around you?
questions.asrs_12: How often do you leave your seat in meetings or other situations where you're expected to stay seated?
questions.asrs_13: How often do you feel restless or uneasy inside?
questions.asrs_14: How often do you have trouble unwinding and relaxing when you have free time?
questions.asrs_15: How often do you find yourself talking too much in social situations?
questions.asrs_16: How often do you finish other people's sentences before they can finish them themselves?
questions.asrs_17: How often do you have trouble waiting your turn when you need to?
questions.asrs_18: How often do you interrupt others when they are busy?

results.description: Your focus and energy are fairly well under control.
There are some signs of inattention or hyperactivity, though they may not meet the full criteria.
What you experience closely resembles an ADHD pattern. Talking to a professional is recommended.
